title: Batik Kembar Hari Jumat
genre: keroncong-dangdut fusion with Middle Eastern groove
subject: an office clerk in Solo who buys a new batik shirt for Batik Friday at a small shop on Jalan Slamet Riyadi, only to discover the shop owner sold the exact same motif to his boss, so every Friday they turn up as twins and the whole floor wants a photo
caption: Keroncong-dangdut fusion with a Middle Eastern groove. Keroncong cak and cuk ukuleles playing interlocking crong-crong strums, suling bamboo flute with bending runs, kendang dangdut with tak-dut patterns, darbuka rolls pushing the groove, violin answering the vocal lines. Warm roomy live-band production, clean and dry. Bright cheeky female mid-high vocal, clearly sung melody with light dangdut ornaments. 112 BPM, D minor. Mood of an office comedy you can dance to. No EDM drops, no koplo remix bass, no autotune, no rap, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - suling run, cak and cuk strumming, kendang enters]
[Verse 1]
Mas Hendra beli batik baru
Motif parang warna merah bata
Kata Bu Ning yang punya toko
Cuma satu, Mas, khusus buat sampeyan
[Pre-Chorus]
Jumat pagi dia masuk kantor
Pintu lift terbuka pelan-pelan
[Chorus]
Batik kembar hari Jumat
Pak Bos pakai motif yang sama
Satu lantai minta foto
Mas Hendra pengin pulang saja
[Verse 2]
Minggu depan dia ganti kawung
Pak Bos juga ganti kawung
Ternyata Bu Ning simpan catatan
Ukuran mereka di satu buku
[Bridge - violin and darbuka break]
Bu Ning senyum di balik meja
Dua pelanggan, satu selera
[Chorus]
Batik kembar hari Jumat
Pak Bos tepuk pundaknya pelan
Seleramu bagus, Hendra
Tahun depan kamu naik jabatan
[Outro - suling and kendang, fade]
Batik kembar
Jumat lagi
